test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

a. No blue is black.

b. No black is white.

c. Some white are grey.

d. All grey are green.

**Conclusions:**

i. Some green are not black.

ii. Some white are green.

iii. All green are grey.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67a234136b46ab226eb82a9ad10b4b67ac592ab229a52593890ec15d31b884df.png] 

Conclusions:

i. Some green are not black → Follow (As no black is white, some white are grey and all grey are green. As black cannot be white which has some part common with grey which whole comes in green, therefore it is true.)

ii. Some white are green → Follow (As some white are grey and all grey are green. As white has some part common with grey which whole comes in green, therefore it is true.)

iii. All green are grey → Does not follow (As all grey are green. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (i) and (ii) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
